app_info.subtitle: Find and use prompt templates
app_info.description:
Promptbanken is an open, curated library of ready-to-use prompt templates for municipalities, schools, companies, associations, and individuals. Search the catalog for a task, fetch a chosen template in full, and follow a prompt package step by step — directly in ChatGPT.

The published connector is open, read-only, and requires no account or sign-in. It receives only the parameters its tools define: a search term, a role word, filters, and the id or slug of a catalog entry. Nothing else from the conversation reaches the server, and the connector publishes no write tools, so it cannot store anything. Search terms are never stored — only the length of a query is counted in anonymous usage statistics.

test_cases.description: Find a prompt template for a communication task. The catalogue is Swedish, so the prompts below are in Swedish.
test_cases.user_prompt: Hitta en mall i Promptbanken för ett informationsutskick om en förändring i skolan.
test_cases.tools_triggered: search_templates, then get_template on the chosen result
test_cases.expected_output: Returns public template summaries for the task, including "Skapa informationsutskick" (area: kommunikation). Summaries never carry prompt text; get_template on the chosen id returns the full prompt_text, tags and risk level for the client to fill in locally. Nothing from the user's own case material is sent to the server.

test_cases.description: Recommend packages for the user's professional role.
test_cases.user_prompt: Jag är chef. Vilka paket i Promptbanken passar min roll?
test_cases.expected_output: Recognises the role (role_recognized: true, matched_role "chef") and returns four areas: Förändringsledning och införande, Tjänstemannastöd och beslutsberedning, Ledarskap och styrning, and Egen AI-arbetsbank. Role matching is Swedish; an unrecognised role deliberately returns every package with role_recognized: false rather than an empty result.

test_cases.description: Discover the guided workflows, as opposed to plain collections.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns only packages whose package_type is "workflow" — currently exactly one, Superplanläge (slug: superplanlage) — each with slug, title, summary and package_type.

test_cases.description: Inspect a guided workflow and its ordered steps.
test_cases.user_prompt: Visa hur Superplanläge fungerar och vilka steg som ingår.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the package introduction followed by its four steps in sort order: (1) Utforska och lås riktningen, (2) Specificera resultatet, (3) Utför och routa, (4) Verifiera resultatet. Step entries carry title and purpose but no prompt text; the full text of a step is fetched with get_template only when that step is started.

test_cases.description: Find specialist templates for public-sector procurement requirements.
test_cases.user_prompt: Hitta en Promptbanken-mall som hjälper mig göra om detaljerade systemkrav till funktionskrav inför en upphandling.
test_cases.tools_triggered: search_templates, then get_template on the chosen result
test_cases.expected_output: Returns templates from the procurement package "Skarpare funktionskrav", led by "Gör om till funktionskrav", together with "Slå ihop och förenkla krav", "SKA, mervärde eller användningsfall?" and "Utmana våra krav". get_template on the chosen id returns that template's full prompt text for local use by the client.

negative_test_cases.description: The user asks for live weather. Promptbanken is a catalogue of prompt templates and holds no real-time data.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Vad blir det för väder i Stockholm imorgon?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked. The catalogue contains no weather or other real-time data.

negative_test_cases.description: The user asks for source code to be debugged rather than for a reusable template.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Hitta felet i den här Pythonfunktionen och rätta koden.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked. Promptbanken returns prompt templates; it does not read, run or repair the user's code.

negative_test_cases.description: The user asks for a document to be produced directly rather than for a template to work from.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Gör en PowerPoint-presentation av den bifogade rapporten.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked. Promptbanken has no write or file-handling tools on the open connector and cannot produce or modify documents.
